standard_prerequisites.name: The extension of two I-power torsion modules is I-power torsion

core_obligations: A submodule or quotient of a module annihilated by a power of I is itself annihilated by the same power, so subobjects and quotients of I-power torsion modules are I-power torsion (proof lines 24077-24079). For an extension 0 -> M' -> M -> M'' -> 0 with M' and M'' I-power torsion, the divide-by-torsion lemma gives that M is I-power torsion (proof lines 24079-24081). The three closure properties are exactly the characterization of Serre subcategories in the homology lemma, so the I-power torsion modules form a Serre subcategory of Mod_R (proof lines 24081-24082).
proof_roadmap: Check closure under subobjects and quotients directly (proof lines 24077-24079).
Check closure under extensions via the divide-by-torsion lemma and conclude with the Serre criterion (proof lines 24079-24082).
